note:
P3T: the TP8 row of the method matrix, at the same mem fraction as the TP1 row.

P3M settled TP1: colocated 0.482s against disaggregated 0.170s. The TP8 numbers this study already had are not comparable to it -- the colocated one ran 3 rollouts (so it reports NO_STEADY_SAMPLES once the first 3 samples are discarded) and the disaggregated one ran at mem fraction 0.85. Without this row the interesting mechanism cannot be stated: colocated showed a 2.1x step from TP1 to TP8 (0.40 -> 0.85 under the old, weaker bar), which fits per-chunk CUDA IPC costing more as the weights shard further, while a buffered NCCL broadcast should be indifferent to TP. Whether disaggregated is flat is the test of that story, and it needs both arms measured the same way.

cells.name: colo_tp8_mf08
cells.note: colocated, TP8, mem fraction 0.8, 7 rollouts. Pairs with p3m_colo_tp1_mf08 (0.482s) to give the TP1/TP8 step a defensible measurement on the colocated side.

cells.name: disagg_tp8_mf08
cells.note: disaggregated, TP8, mem fraction 0.8, 7 rollouts. The cell that decides whether the TP1/TP8 step exists on the distributed side at all.

comparisons.label: method at TP8, matched mem fraction

comparisons_note: ACTOR_* / ROLLOUT_NUM_GPUS / CLUSTER_GPUS are listed as ignored in the method comparison because the placement IS the GPU layout: colocated shares 8 devices while disaggregated takes 8 + 8, so requiring them to match would forbid the comparison the study exists to make. Every other key must agree, and any key not listed anywhere is refused rather than assumed harmless -- the 0.8-vs-0.85 pair that motivated this matrix was an omission from an allowlist.
